forbidden: replacing a desktop task with run_fleet.py

codex.same_task_native_wake_notes: Codex thread automations (kind=heartbeat) resume the current thread. Do not invent a target_thread_id. Standalone automations start a new chat and must not be labelled same-task wake.
codex.enablement: operator --enable-native-wake --project <abs-path>, then bind a thread automation from the current Codex task

claude.same_task_native_wake_notes: Claude Code /loop is session-scoped. Desktop scheduled tasks start a fresh session; that is GitHub-recovery wake, not same-task wake.
claude.enablement: none; report the gap instead of installing a fresh-session schedule as same-task wake

cursor.same_task_native_wake_notes: The Cursor loop skill can wake the same agent turn while the session lives. Cursor Automations start a new agent and must not be labelled same-task wake.
cursor.enablement: none; report the gap instead of installing a Cursor Automation as same-task wake

antigravity.same_task_native_wake_notes: /goal continues the current task until the goal finishes. /schedule launches a project-scoped background agent (new conversation) that must recover from GitHub. Both require the operator to enable them in the selected project.
antigravity.enablement: operator --enable-native-wake --project <abs-path>, then /goal or /schedule in that project
